entries.title: Psalms 82:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of Asaph.> God is in the meeting-place of God; he is judging among the gods.

entries.title: Psalms 82:2
segments: How long will you go on judging falsely, having respect for the persons of evil-doers? (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 82:3
segments: Give ear to the cause of the poor and the children without fathers; let those who are troubled and in need have their rights.

entries.title: Psalms 82:4
segments: Be the saviour of the poor and those who have nothing: take them out of the hand of the evil-doers.

entries.title: Psalms 82:5
segments: They have no knowledge or sense; they go about in the dark: all the bases of the earth are moved.

entries.title: Psalms 82:6
segments: ¶I said, You are gods; all of you are the sons of the Most High:

entries.title: Psalms 82:7
segments: But you will come to death like men, falling like one of the rulers of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 82:8
segments: Up! O God, come as judge of the earth; for all the nations are your heritage.
